name: daily-quest-tracker
description: Daily Quest Tracker is a MERN stack RPG-style productivity app that turns habit-building into a game. Users create personal quests (habits or goals), earn XP for completing them, level up, unlock badges, and join guilds with friends to share progress and stay motivated.

scripts.dev: (trap 'kill 0' SIGINT EXIT; npm run dev --workspace server & npm run dev --workspace client)
